Then 0<=C_z<=delta/ln(2). On the original parity-pair shadow g(zu,y), partner-deletion influence-weighted KL loss is L=M_z. For any fresh balanced Boolean encoder h, query actual u first in F=g(u h(x),y), then resolve the encoder completely, retaining y: the variance-weighted shadow bill Q=B_z, hence Q-L=C_z. If E_h is the fair expected cumulative inherited encoder erasure, averaged over partner branches, and T_K is the actual terminal surplus E[K I(g_leaf)-H(g_leaf)] at bit price K, then T_K-(B_z+delta E_h)=K I(g)-H(g)+JS_z(g)-(K+E_h)delta, while T_K-(M_z+delta E_h) adds C_z to that margin. No universal reserve payment or FEI disproof is asserted.
